attempts.text:
**The window starts on a single spine column.** Column 0, `cspH`, is carried by 100% of chromosomes, persistent, and in a region of plasticity in 77% of calls, the most of any column. The model names it in 99% of calls, with 0.30 bits.

**Then the graph opens at the `gfc` fork.** Columns 1 to 4 carry `gfcA` to `gfcD`, shell families at 67 to 69%, and a second branch of 3 families, `ymcF`, `ymcE` and `gnsA`, at 10%. Columns 5 to 71 are variable, 58 to 90%, and the model names 74 to 99% of calls there, fewest at column 65, 74%.

**The variable middle carries many families.** `appA` to `hyaA` sit at 89 to 90%, the `elf` fimbrial genes at 58 to 65%, and `ssuE` to `ssuB` at 83 to 84%. The most hesitant columns are 48, 46 and 47, `elfC`, `ycbU` and `elfG`, at 0.71, 0.57 and 0.55 bits, in a region of plasticity in 64 to 67% of calls.

**The window ends in forks again.** Columns 72 to 79 carry `ycaQ` to `ycaL`, persistent at 76 to 84%, with second branches of 4 families, `pflA` to `dmsC`, at 10 to 18%, and 3 families, `ycaO`, `focA` and `pflB`, at 23 to 26%. The window ends at column 79, `ycaL`, in 76% of chromosomes.

**Inside a region of plasticity the model hesitates more and names fewer genes.** Across the window it names 94% of genes at 0.26 bits; inside a region of plasticity 80% at 0.89 bits against 97% at 0.12 bits outside. The 14 columns most in regions of plasticity are named 93% at 0.42 bits, the other 66 columns 94% at 0.23 bits.

label: cspH
facts:
WINDOW: the cspH window: 80 columns, column 0 is the anchor cspH, then the next 79 genes in dnaA's direction; about genes 2,702 to 2,781 from dnaA. Read in 527 of the 540 complete chromosomes (those carrying cspH once); 42,160 calls of the model, each on a chromosome's real proteins.
TERMS: share: chromosomes carrying the family in the window. named: calls where the model names the gene at that column from the genes before it. bits: the model's entropy there, its hesitation (the more bits, the more hesitant). perplexity (whole window only): how surprised the model is by the real gene. RGP N%: N% of the calls there are on a gene inside a region of genomic plasticity (panRGP). P/S/C: persistent, shell, cloud (PPanGGOLiN). Spine column: one family in 90% of chromosomes or more; fork: a second family in 10% or more; variable: neither. A persistent family is in nearly every chromosome: in a fork or variable column its lower share means it lies beyond the window's end in the other chromosomes (genes inserted upstream push it out); never call it rare or say they lack it.
WHOLE WINDOW: the model names 94% of genes, 0.26 bits on average (perplexity 1.4 families). By partition of the gene: persistent 34,717 calls, named 98%, 0.12 bits; shell 7,140 calls, named 80%, 0.81 bits; cloud 303 calls, named 12%, 3.66 bits. Outside an RGP 34,512 calls, named 97%, 0.12 bits; inside an RGP 7,648 calls, named 80%, 0.89 bits. Columns: 1 spine, 12 fork, 67 variable.
COMPARISON (computed, over calls): inside an RGP the model hesitates more than outside (0.89 against 0.12 bits) and names fewer genes (80% against 97%); 7,648 of the 42,160 calls are inside an RGP.
HESITATION: the most hesitant columns of the window: column 48 (elfC) 0.71 bits, RGP 64%; column 46 (ycbU) 0.57 bits, RGP 67%; column 47 (elfG) 0.55 bits, RGP 65%. The 14 columns where most calls are in an RGP: named 93%, 0.42 bits on average; the other 66 columns: named 94%, 0.23 bits.
PLASTICITY: the stretch most in regions of plasticity: column 0 (spine), RGP 77%; the least: columns 1-79 (fork and variable columns), RGP 1-77%.
STRETCHES, in window order (each spine; between spines, the fork and variable columns; the family listed is the most carried at its column; share of chromosomes; RGP: range over the columns):
1. column 0 spine: share 100%, all P, RGP 77%. Genes: cspH. named 99%; 0.30 bits.
2. columns 1-79 (79 columns) fork and variable columns: RGP 1-77%. named 74-99% (mean 94%), fewest named at column 65, named 74%; most hesitant at column 48, 0.71 bits.
   a second branch of 3 families through columns 2-4, a parallel path that some chromosomes carry instead of the most carried families there, each following the previous one in most of its chromosomes, share 10%, all P; the branch's families: ymcF, ymcE, gnsA
   a second branch of 4 families through columns 72-75, a parallel path that some chromosomes carry instead of the most carried families there, each following the previous one in most of its chromosomes, share 10-18%, all P; the branch's families: pflA, ycaD, ycaC, dmsC
   a second branch of 3 families through columns 76-78, a parallel path that some chromosomes carry instead of the most carried families there, each following the previous one in most of its chromosomes, share 23-26%, all P; the branch's families: ycaO, focA, pflB
   1 fork: gfcA S 69%; also "IS1-like element transposase" S 19%, cspG P 10%
